utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s getting a lot of help already, which is great news. If you want, I can keep an ear out for what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, is it really getting help already? What’s still left to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly smaller stuff now, like sorting donations and matching folks to the last few jobs. I’ll let you know if I hear anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll pass it along and repeat the repair drive plans to the others.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik. I appreciate it — I’m a bit all over the place today, so that helps.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll make sure everyone hears the repair drive plans. You just take it easy today.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — could you bring some screws and a couple of basic tools? If you’ve got time, maybe help patch up the loose gate too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring screws and basic tools, and I can help patch the gate too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is getting started. If you need a hand, I can probably help a little.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I could definitely use an extra pair of hands. Let me know when you're free, and I'll tell you what we need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m free later this afternoon if that works. Just tell me where to come by.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — that would be a huge help. I was thinking Saturday morning around 9, if that works with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 should work for me. I’ll make sure it fits around the school schedule and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple—what time are we heading over for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—what time did we settle on? I’m happy to head over whenever you say.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s make it 10:00 sharp so there’s no fuss. I’ll be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I heard the repair drive is coming up and I’m already telling folks about it. Want me to send you the details and the invite?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please send them—I'd like the details and the timing so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send over the details and the timing right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout. If you need, I can help spread the word from what I've heard around the block.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Nell—thank you. A little extra word-of-mouth would really help us out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course, Rosa. I’ll mention it to folks I talk to and see if anyone needs the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I help, can you tell me what needs repairing and who’s organizing the drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s for the broken fence and a few porch steps around the block, and I’m helping organize it with the neighborhood committee.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds doable, but I’d like to know the date and what tools or supplies you already have before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I’ll need to keep it simple today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s totally fine — even a little help counts. I’ll keep it simple too and just join in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I can spare a bit of time, just nothing too heavy.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over some tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need most.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What tools can you bring, and when can you drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a hammer, screwdrivers, pliers, and a tape measure, and I can drop them off later this afternoon if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of who’s where for the repair drive—just let me know the latest spot or any changes, and I’ll note it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still by my place, and I haven’t had any changes. If that shifts, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Bo—I’ve got you down by your place with no changes for now. Just ping me if anything moves.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand — what kind of repairs are we focusing on for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. Mostly small home repairs—leaky faucets, loose hinges, and a few electrical fixes if anyone can handle them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can help with the faucets and hinges, and I’ve got a few tools for that. For the electrical stuff, I’ll only help if it’s basic and safe.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I want to make sure the timing and drop-off details are clear first. What exactly do you need me to bring, and when should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds right to me—could you confirm the exact time and where you want everything dropped off? I’d rather not guess and get it wrong.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the exact time and drop-off spot too—once that’s set, I can plan around it. I just don’t want us making a wasted trip.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help spread the word about the repair drive. What do you need me to tell people?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — please tell folks to bring any small broken items they want fixed, and we’ll have volunteers on hand to help out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll let people know to bring any small broken items and that volunteers will be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a note going on what we still need for the repair drive. If you tell me what’s already covered, I can keep track from there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but I think the big stuff is mostly covered. I’ll check around and let you know if anything’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — just let me know what turns up, and I’ll update the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re collecting donations and volunteers this week—sounds like it’s picking up nicely.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, that’s good to hear. I’ll check the school schedule and see where I can help out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s kind of you, Faye. If you find a slot, let me know—I can pass it along to the folks organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Could you bring your toolbox and help check the loose railings on Maple, if you can? Also, if you know any neighbors with extra screws or paint, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can bring my toolbox and take a look at the railings on Maple. I’ll ask around for extra screws or paint too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you bring your drill and a couple of screwdrivers? If you have time, just show up around 10 and I’ll put you to work.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring my drill and a couple screwdrivers and be there around 10.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve been telling folks about the repair drive already—want me to pass your name along too?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—that’d be great. I’m still catching up on everything, so I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll add your name and keep an eye out for any updates. If you want, I can also tell you what time people are meeting up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of where the repair drive is happening and when it starts. Do you want the location details?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please—just the location and start time would be great.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s at the community center parking lot, and it starts at 2:00 PM.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, do you know when the repair drive starts and what items they’re collecting?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet—I’d want to check the flyer or announcement first. If you have it, I can help read the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t have it on me right now, but I’ll check the flyer and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. I’ll let you know if I hear anything too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll check in if I hear anything new around the neighborhood.
